mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO schedule_record ( user_id, biz_date, record_type, start_time, end_time, activity_type, create_time, update_time ) VALUES
( #{record.userId}, #{record.bizDate}, #{record.recordType}, #{record.startTime}, #{record.endTime}, #{record.activityType}, NOW(), NOW() )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE activity_type = VALUES(activity_type), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT sr.* FROM schedule_record sr INNER JOIN goal_activity_type_relation gar ON sr.user_id = gar.user_id AND sr.activity_type = gar.type_code WHERE sr.user_id = #{userId} AND gar.goal_id = #{goalId} AND record_type = 'actual'
